entry.summary: No Smartraveller page and no Australian-specific official source found on 31 October 2026 for Cape Verde. Aggregator sites disagree. Cape Verde runs an online pre-registration (EASE) with an airport security fee for visa-free nationalities.
entry.next_check: Ask Cape Verde's embassy or immigration authority which visa an Australian needs.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: Visa-free for business visits up to 30 days.
visa-preparation.recheck_note: Not verified 2026-11-01: no Smartraveller advice. The Cabo Verde government (gov.cv) visa-exempt list doesn't include Australia, so a visa is needed; EASE pre-registration and the Airport Security Fee (CVE 3,400, gov.cv/pedir-tsa) apply. The tourist visa fee wasn't found on gov.cv.
